note: DRAFT. Sandboxed patch verification, execution limits, safety controls, and test result taxonomy owned by Workstream B.

fail_to_pass: test identifiers expected to fail before fix and pass after
pass_to_pass: test identifiers expected to remain passing (regression suite)

status_definitions.VERIFIED: All fail_to_pass tests transitioned to PASS and 100% of pass_to_pass tests remained PASS.
status_definitions.TEST_FAILED: Test suite executed, but one or more fail_to_pass tests did not pass, or a pass_to_pass regression occurred.
status_definitions.SETUP_FAILED: Target environment could not prepare test dependencies or syntax error prevented test collection.
status_definitions.PATCH_REJECTED: Patch failed validation (prohibited file, path traversal, or syntax error).
status_definitions.ENVIRONMENT_ERROR: Host / OS failure (e.g. disk full, permission denied creating worktree).

verification_result.stdout_tail: string (last N bytes of execution stdout)
verification_result.stderr_tail: string (last N bytes of execution stderr)
verification_result.artifacts_uri: optional URI / path to preserved run logs

safety_controls: Patches executed only in isolated disposable worktrees or containers.
All host API keys, tokens, and credentials scrubbed from child process environment.
Execution commands strictly constrained to allowlisted test runners (pytest, python -m unittest).
Model cannot provide or alter execution shell commands.
